title: Personal Element
author: 640e03081170df1b3696850b
chapter_outcomes: Select a topic and identify a relevant local issue for collaborative research
Conduct research on a local issue and explore different perspectives
Collaborate effectively with team members to plan and carry out an action
Assign roles and responsibilities clearly within the team
Develop a strategic Explanation of Research and Planning document
Produce Evidence of Action demonstrating the implementation of the planned project
Measure and evaluate the success and impact of the team’s action
Communicate ideas clearly and share information within the team
Solve problems, meet deadlines, and be flexible during the project
Recognize and value the contributions of all team members
Reflect on personal research findings and their contribution to the team project
Evaluate personal learning, teamwork, and the effectiveness of actions taken
Present structured, coherent, and reflective writing in the individual Reflective Paper
Use evidence and examples to support reflections and evaluations
